title: "process has died [pid, exit code -11]" in ros2 launch: what -11, -6, -9, 1 and 127 mean, finding the real error, gdb, respawn and Shutdown, measured
excerpt: Exit code -11 is a segfault, -6 an abort, -9 a kill, 127 a missing library. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical: where the real error prints, gdb and PYTHONFAULTHANDLER backtraces, respawn and on_exit=Shutdown, and why ros2 launch still exits 0.
